snippet.title: “ SUPER UFO FIGHTER” How to play/Trailer
snippet.description:
【Demo with online play is now available!】
SUPER UFO FIGHTER  is a 1v1 casual action game with cute UFOs battling each other!
The game is based on an UFO catcher motif, and has simple controls to move the UFOs, break the boxes, and pull things. Win by pulling more of the target items into your goal than the other UFO! Use your character's skills and the stage's gimmicks to enjoy strategic and ^exciting battles!

▶The demo version is available for a limited time only! (July 24th~)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1277870/_/

▶Official Site
http://vv-labo.com/ufosports-jp/
